items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: He was like the Stuff Smith of his day.

ctx.x: Yeah, and we had this little guy named Claud -- what was Claud's last name? That played a fiddle with a horn on it. He was like the Stuff Smith of his day. One of the great violin players that I don't think the world knows too much about.
